# Let’s talk!

::: lead
Whether you are interested in psychological services, a research collaboration, consulting, or training, tell me briefly what you would like to discuss.
:::
:::::

:::::: contact-layout
::: contact-panel
## Send me a message

Fill in the fields and choose whether to open your message in your email app or WhatsApp.

```{=html}
<form id="contact-compose-form">
  <label for="contact-name">Your name</label>
  <input id="contact-name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name" maxlength="120" required placeholder="Full name">

  <label for="contact-topic">What are you contacting me about?</label>
  <select id="contact-topic" name="topic" required>
    <option value="Psychology and neuropsychology">Psychology and neuropsychology</option>
    <option value="Research and collaborations">Research and collaborations</option>
    <option value="Training and science communication">Training and science communication</option>
    <option value="Other">Other</option>
  </select>

  <label for="contact-message">Your message</label>
  <textarea id="contact-message" name="message" rows="6" maxlength="3000" required placeholder="Write your message here..."></textarea>

  <p class="contact-privacy">To protect your privacy, please do not include health information or other sensitive personal data in this initial message.</p>

  <div class="contact-actions">
    <button type="button" class="contact-action contact-email" id="compose-email">✉️ Write to me by email</button>
    <button type="button" class="contact-action contact-whatsapp" id="compose-whatsapp">◉ Message me on WhatsApp</button>
  </div>

  <p class="contact-note">Your email app or WhatsApp will open with a draft message. You can review it and choose whether to send it.</p>
</form>
```
:::

<style>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function initializeContactForm() {
    const form = document.getElementById('contact-compose-form');
    const emailButton = document.getElementById('compose-email');
    const whatsappButton = document.getElementById('compose-whatsapp');
    if (!form || !emailButton || !whatsappButton) return;

    function compose() {
      if (!form.reportValidity()) return null;
      const name = document.getElementById('contact-name').value.trim();
      const topic = document.getElementById('contact-topic').value;
      const message = document.getElementById('contact-message').value.trim();
      if (!name || !message) {
        alert('Please enter your name and a message.');
        return null;
      }
      return { topic, body: `Hello, my name is ${name}.\n\nI am contacting you about: ${topic}.\n\n${message}` };
    }

    emailButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
      const data = compose();
      if (!data) return;
      const subject = encodeURIComponent('Website enquiry – ' + data.topic);
      const body = encodeURIComponent(data.body);
      window.location.href = `mailto:desi.carioti@gmail.com?subject=${subject}&body=${body}`;
    });

    whatsappButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
      const data = compose();
      if (!data) return;
      const url = `https://wa.me/393406969587?text=${encodeURIComponent(data.body)}`;
      window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeContactForm);
  } else {
    initializeContactForm();
  }
})();
</script>
```
